english.note: Use this when the recreation is specifically a leisure pastime or a way to relax.
Use this when relaxation means leisure or recreation undertaken for enjoyment and mental relief.

examples.english: After retiring, I garden every day for recreation.
examples.traditional: 退休之後，我每日都用種花嚟消閒。

examples.english: I most enjoy gaming for relaxation in my spare time.
examples.traditional: 我平日最鍾意打機消閒。
